farine-de-fonio.name: Fonio Flour
farine-de-fonio.subtitle: PURE FONIO GRAINS
farine-de-fonio.description:
Naturally gluten-free, light and easy to digest, our fonio flour is made from carefully selected, finely milled fonio grains.

Rich in fibre, protein, carbohydrates, minerals and B vitamins, it provides around 360 kcal per 100 g.

Ideal for porridges, crêpes, breads, biscuits, pastries and sauces, it fits easily into a varied, balanced diet.

100% fonio | Gluten-free | Versatile | Local product
benefits: Rich in carbohydrates, protein, fibre, minerals and B vitamins

fonio-grain.name: Fonio Grains
fonio-grain.subtitle: PURE FONIO GRAINS
fonio-grain.description: Fonio is a gluten-free cereal grain about 1.3 mm long and 0.8 mm wide, rich in energy, carbohydrates, protein, fibre, minerals (iron, magnesium, zinc, calcium) and B vitamins. Light and easy to digest, it provides around 360 kcal per 100 g.
fonio-grain.detailed_description: Grown on the lands of Atacora in northern Benin, Boukoumbé fonio is an ancestral grain with many virtues. Gluten-free and easy to digest, it is rich in fibre, essential fatty acids, amino acids and slow-release carbohydrates — a valuable ally for a balanced diet.
benefits: Rich in fibre, essential fatty acids, amino acids and slow-release carbohydrates

preparation.ratio: 1 measure of fonio = 8 measures of water

recipes.name: Fonio grain porridge
steps: Bring water to the boil, then pour in the desired amount of fonio.
Put the lid back on and leave to cook for 10 to 13 minutes.
Add water if the consistency seems too thick, then cook for another 2 to 4 minutes.
Add baobab pulp or néré powder and a moderate amount of sugar.

recipes.name: Fonio pâte (stiff porridge)
steps: Bring water to the boil, then pour in the desired amount of fonio.
Stir with a spatula until smooth, then put the lid back on.
Leave to cook for 5 to 10 minutes and stir again. You will get a thick, firm mixture, like maize pâte.
For red pâte, replace the water with tomato sauce and follow the same method.
